reason: My neighborhood mithai shop gives free sweet and green chutney with samosas, so spending ₹99 on 100g of packaged sauce that might squirt out water is a waste.
objection: Does watery liquid squirt out first before the thick chutney comes out, and is ₹99 justified for 100g?
would_change_my_mind: A value pack under ₹60 and an anti-separation formulation that never leaks water.
